content:
elaine: Heads-up: support got a ticket — customer saw a -9 provisional on console after a retry+handoff during streaming.
rex: paste logs?
elaine: small snippet: 
```
2026-09-01T11:05:10Z router: session=abc123 route=us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 reason=burst_failover
2026-09-01T11:05:10Z runtime: session=abc123 prefix_len=20 tokens_emitted=31 status=stream
2026-09-01T11:05:11Z runtime: session=abc123 toolcall=ocr truncated=true tokens_tool=9
2026-09-01T11:05:13Z billing: session=abc123 provisional_credit=+0 owner=us-west-2
2026-09-01T11:05:14Z billing: session=abc123 reconcile_adjust=-9 owner=eu-west-1
```
sam: sounds like provisional fast-path skipped (truncation) and reconcile landed on new owner after handoff => orphan negative.
irene: router overwrites route_tag during handoff so ledger keys diverge. we need provenance.
rex: proposal: router writes X-Orig-Owner on handoff; runtime emits prov_id for truncated toolcalls; ledger reconcile will lookup prov_id and merge provisional or create placeholder instead of naked negative.
ben: low-risk short-term: console should label negatives "pending reconciliation" and suppress auto-refund for single-session negatives < 10 tokens.
elaine: agree. ops-bot: INC-2026-900 created, assign eng-platform.
ops-bot: rollout suggestion: router header (canary 10%), runtime prov_id emit, ledger reconcile lookup + placeholder (canary 5%).
sam: tests: simulate toolcall truncated pre-handoff and confirm no negative appears after reconcile.
irene: add alert: cross-shard negative rate > 1/min -> page SRE.
rex: timeline: router change (1d), runtime (0.5d), ledger reconcile patch (2d), console UX (0.5d).
ben: tl;dr: root cause = missing provenance when route/owner mutates mid-stream + skipped provisional; fix = provenance + reconcile merge + UX bandaid.
elaine: I'll open the console PR and the support template. cc @rex for router PR.
